description: Korea Expressway Corporation public data portal (고속도로 공공데이터 포털) is a data portal run by Korea Expressway Corporation. The portal offers expressway traffic volumes, tolls, incident, road-section, rest-area and facility data of the state highway operator as files and open APIs. Coverage: South Korea (expressways). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, api; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("고속도로 공공데이터 포털") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support expressway traffic and network studies of Korea. Related records: data-korea-expressway-public-data-portal are catalogued from the same site.
